firsthunt.frontierhunts.screen.title: Your first hunt
firsthunt.frontierhunts.screen.lead: One whitetail deer, start to finish: get permission, read the sign, come in with the wind, shoot, track, field-dress, then collect your reward.
firsthunt.frontierhunts.screen.not_start: Take one whitetail deer from start to finish, one step at a time: permission, sign, wind, shot, tracking, harvest and the reward. Press Start: the card in the top-left corner shows only the step you are on.
firsthunt.frontierhunts.screen.done: Your first hunt is done and the reward (%s tokens and field arrows) is in your pack. The Handbook's steps and Mara's contracts take it from here.
firsthunt.frontierhunts.step.permit.how: Whitetail deer need a hunting licence and a deer tag, valid this licence season, and the deer season must be open. Your paperwork is checked below. New hunters can take one free starter permit right here: a licence, one deer tag, and a skinning knife if you have none.
firsthunt.frontierhunts.step.signs.title: Find deer sign
firsthunt.frontierhunts.step.signs.card: Look at the ground and right-click a print, a bed or droppings to read it.
firsthunt.frontierhunts.step.signs.how: Walk to the beginner area and look down: hoof prints, beds, rubs and droppings show where deer feed, rest and travel. Right-click any sign to read it: how old it is, which way it goes, what made it.
firsthunt.frontierhunts.step.wind.title: Come in with the wind
firsthunt.frontierhunts.step.wind.card: Deer smell you downwind of you. Get within 30 blocks of a calm deer with the wind blowing from the deer to you.
firsthunt.frontierhunts.step.wind.good: Good: the wind is in your favour. Hold here, quiet… %s of %s
firsthunt.frontierhunts.step.wind.how: A deer's nose is its best sense. Stay on the side the wind blows toward (the deer's downwind side), so your scent drifts away from it. Hold the wind checker to see the wind. Crouch and move slowly; a calm deer close by, with the wind in your face for a few seconds, completes this step.
firsthunt.frontierhunts.step.shot.title: Take a clean shot
firsthunt.frontierhunts.step.shot.card: Draw your bow on a calm deer, side-on, and aim just behind the front leg.
firsthunt.frontierhunts.step.shot.how: Wait for the deer to stand broadside, calm and close: under 30 blocks with the field bow. Your arrow lands where the crosshair is. Aim at the heart and lungs, just behind the front leg, a third of the way up the body.
firsthunt.frontierhunts.step.track.title: Track it
firsthunt.frontierhunts.step.track.card: Follow the blood. Right-click a drop to read it, or walk up on the deer.
firsthunt.frontierhunts.step.track.how: A hit deer usually runs before it goes down. Wait a moment, then follow its blood trail: right-click a drop to read how fresh it is and which way it went. Bright, frothy blood means a lung hit. Walk up on the downed deer to finish this step.
firsthunt.frontierhunts.step.harvest.car: Use your deer tag on the downed deer, then right-click it with the skinning knife and stay close.
firsthunt.frontierhunts.step.harvest.how: First use your deer tag on the deer (the law says a deer is tagged before it's moved or skinned). Then hold the Contour Skinning Knife, right-click the deer and stay beside it until skinning finishes: you get venison, the hide and a trophy. No knife? Craft one from an iron ingot, a stick and leather.
firsthunt.frontierhunts.step.claim.title: Collect your reward
firsthunt.frontierhunts.step.claim.card: Open the first-hunt page and claim %s tokens and a bundle of arrows.
firsthunt.frontierhunts.step.claim.how: That's a whole hunt, done right. Claim your reward: %s tokens and eight field arrows. Spend tokens at the ranger counters on next season's licence and tags.
firsthunt.frontierhunts.step.done.title: First hunt done
firsthunt.frontierhunts.step.done.card: First hunt done. The Handbook and the journal take it from here.
firsthunt.frontierhunts.step.done.how: You did the whole thing: paperwork, sign, wind, shot, track and harvest. From here, the Handbook and the hunting journal cover every other animal, and the ranger counters sell next season's licence and tags.
firsthunt.frontierhunts.permit.line.susp: Your licence is suspended this season: the warden won't let you hunt deer until the next one.
firsthunt.frontierhunts.permit.line.free: You need a licence and a deer tag. Take the free starter permit: press %s, open First hunt.
firsthunt.frontierhunts.permit.line.buy: You need a licence and a deer tag: buy them at a ranger counter (%s › First hunt shows the nearest).
firsthunt.frontierhunts.permit.line.clos: Your paperwork is in order, but deer season is closed: it opens in %s days (%s).
firsthunt.frontierhunts.permit.line.ok: Licence, tag and season all good.
firsthunt.frontierhunts.permit.issued: Free starter permit: a hunting licence and one deer tag for the %s (and a skinning knife for the harvest). They're in your pack.
firsthunt.frontierhunts.permit.suspended: Your licence is suspended this season: no permit can be issued.
firsthunt.frontierhunts.permit.bag: You have already had every deer tag this season allows.
firsthunt.frontierhunts.licence.off: Licences are switched off on this server: no paperwork needed. Any season is open.
firsthunt.frontierhunts.licence.route_ca: Buy a licence and a deer tag at the ranger counter of the hunting camp at %s, %s (%s blocks away), or any expedition board, contract board, lodge stores or ranger window.
firsthunt.frontierhunts.licence.route: Buy a licence and a deer tag at any ranger counter: an expedition board, contract board, lodge stores, ranger window or a camp post.
firsthunt.frontierhunts.licence.free_not: Once per hunter, free: a licence, one deer tag and a skinning knife if you have none.
firsthunt.frontierhunts.area.scouting: Looking for deer near you: explore a little and a beginner area will be marked.
firsthunt.frontierhunts.area.away: Beginner area: about %s blocks to the %s.
firsthunt.frontierhunts.area.quiet_short: This area has gone quiet: open First hunt for another.
firsthunt.frontierhunts.area.quiet: No deer about here now. Open the Handbook › First hunt to get another area.
firsthunt.frontierhunts.area.none: No other area with deer known nearby yet. Explore a little and ask again.
firsthunt.frontierhunts.advice.0: Look for tracks along the meadow edge, where the deer come out to feed at dawn and dusk.
firsthunt.frontierhunts.advice.1: Work slowly along the forest edge and read the ground: prints and droppings lead to where they feed.
firsthunt.frontierhunts.advice.2: Check the soft ground by the water: deer come down to drink, and prints show well in mud.
firsthunt.frontierhunts.advice.3: Deer bed in thick cover here: look for flattened beds and droppings, and go quietly.
firsthunt.frontierhunts.advice.4: No deer seen here yet: look for fresh tracks and droppings first.
firsthunt.frontierhunts.hint.wind: Too much scent: come in from the %s side of the deer, so the wind blows from it to you.
firsthunt.frontierhunts.hint.winded: It smelled you! The wind is blowing toward the %s: come round to that side.
firsthunt.frontierhunts.claimed: First hunt complete! Reward: %s tokens and %s field arrows.
